lines.text: What could you possibly want, coming back\nhere now?\r\nBecause of you, Team Rocket was disbanded...
It’s not my style to be emotional, but I\nwanted to give you a glimpse of how I felt.
To tell you the truth...\c\nI thought you might show up, so I was writing\na letter to you.

“Dear [VAR TRNAME(0000)],\c
“Congratulations on conquering
the Pokémon League.\c
“I hold no grudges against you for what you did
to Team Rocket.\c
“Instead, using this defeat as a springboard,
I would like to create an even stronger
Team Rocket and officially announce
our comeback.\c
“I will leave the Kanto region.
I wish for your continued success here in Kanto.\c
“Farewell.
                                             Archer”
ARCHER: What did I want you to think about me\nby writing such a letter...?\r\nHumph.
